description.default: An infinite canvas for SiYuan: lay out local files, SiYuan notes and internal assets side by side, connect them with edges, and export a PNG. Note cards show their title and outline, .canvas files embed into notes as read-only previews, and local files can be dragged straight from the Local Storage plugin tree onto the canvas. Reuses the Local Storage plugin, so there is nothing to configure twice.
description.zh_CN: 盘绘给思源加一张无限画布：把本机文件、思源笔记与内部资源铺在一起，用连线梳理关系，并可一键导出 PNG。笔记卡片默认只显示标题与大纲，.canvas 可作为只读预览块嵌进笔记正文，本机文件也能从「本机存储」插件文件树直接拖入画布。文件读取直接复用「本机存储」插件，无需在画布侧重复配置。
